target_customer: Freight and logistics facilities (warehouses, yards, distribution sites) that pay security agencies for gate check-in and monitoring
problem: Facilities staff gates around the clock with human guards to check in truck drivers and verify paperwork, which is costly, error-prone and open to cargo theft.
business_model: AI workers sold as an operated service for facility operations (the company says it owns the work rather than selling a software tool); pricing not public
product_category: AI agents for logistics facility operations (gate check-in and site monitoring)

founders.name: Addwiteey Chrungoo
previous_startups: Javelin Robotics (autonomy for trucks, introduced in a July 2023 YC launch post with Sandesh)
A freight company he says he ran (name not given)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built autonomy for the CAT 797F autonomous truck and calls himself a 2x founder. Education is not listed on the page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Today's product stitches existing cameras, intercoms and facility systems to AI that reads documents, speaks and follows procedures. That is standard applied AI engineering with integration work across varied site hardware; rated from the 2025 product description since no 2021 product is documented.

defensibility.rationale: The site names no customers and describes software layered on existing hardware, so rivals can copy the approach. Operational data from check-ins (12,000 claimed) is the only visible accumulation.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not determined. Search results showed other gate automation startups (for example EAIGLE, which announced a growth round in 2026), but nothing about incumbents acting against Supadock.

market_need_then: The company says facilities pay security agencies for manual gate check-in and that cargo theft exploits it. No 2021 demand evidence for this specific product was found.

branding.domain_note: Site is at getsupadock.com, a get-prefixed domain, so the exact .com was apparently not used; no purchase history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and concise with short headlines such as Every entry. Every exit. Handled., focused on operational efficiency.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand material about Supadock was found; a branding search returned nothing relevant. The site footer names Javelin Robotics Inc. as the legal entity.

outcome_analysis: Supadock is listed as Active with a team of one. The YC page gives a founding year of 2025 despite the Winter 2021 batch tag and ties the founder to Javelin Robotics, whose legal name appears on the site, so the history between 2021 and 2025 is unclear. The company claims 12,000 gate check-ins since June and sells AI workers for gate operations. No funding, exit or failure was found, so the story is early and unproven.
notes: Funding searches found no Supadock round; a Dealroom enterprise value of 500k to 750k seen only in a search snippet is unverified and not recorded. The YC founding year (2025) conflicts with the Winter 2021 batch and with an aggregator saying 2023. Sandesh is not recorded as a founder because the YC page does not list him for Supadock. No dated competitors near 2021 were found in searches; later gate automation entrants exist. Completeness pass: two searches found no funding for Supadock.
